d: stc Kuwait is actively recruiting for the role of Director - Pricing and Profitability. In this role, you will be responsible for overall pricing evaluation and profitability functions of the company.
r: Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:
Evaluating pricing proposals from various segments/products owners and provide expert advice to immediate supervisor.
Proactively interacting with the relevant product owners to suggest alternate options where the original proposal entail commercial/financial bottlenecks.
Maintaining a reporting framework necessary to evaluate the product pricing decisions.
Maintaining an analysis framework to ensure post-launch analysis is done for major pricing decisions in a systematic manner.
Supporting company’s digital initiatives by minimizing the manual processes.
Maintaining interactive and digital dashboards environment to provide effective information on a timely manner.
Ensuring periodical profitability statements are available at all times at various levels (segments, services, business units, products etc.)
Preparing business cases for one-off strategic projects as and when needed by the top management.
Providing support to immediate manager in meeting digitization and other strategic objectives of the company.
Performing other tasks as advised by the immediate manager.
To apply to this role, please make sure that you meet the following criteria:
Bachelor degree in a relevant field.
A minimum of 8-10 years of experience.
Telcom business acumen is a must.

The IT Auditor Specialist will be responsible for planning and executing technology and information systems audits across the telecommunications environment. The role will assess the effectiveness of IT controls, information security, technology governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks, while identify control gaps and recommend practical improvements. The position will work closely with IT, Information Security, Network Operations, Finance, Business Operations, and other stakeholders to evaluate technology risks and strengthen the organization's overall control environment.
q: Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or related field.
Minimum 4 years of experience in IT Audit, IT Risk, IT Controls, or Information Security.
Telecom operators or telecommunications service providers
Good knowledge of ITGCs, cybersecurity, network controls, and technology risk.
Professional certification such as CISA, CIA, CISM, CISSP, or CRISC is preferred.
Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Ability to work independently and interact effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
Deliver audits as per plan and timeline.
Ensure timely closure of audit actions.
Maintain strong leadership confidence in audit outcomes.
Use data analytics to enhance audit quality and efficiency.
r: Plan and execute risk-based IT audits across IT, network, applications, infrastructure, and cybersecurity.
Assess IT General Controls (ITGCs), application controls, access management, change management, backup, and disaster recovery.
Audit telecom OSS/BSS, billing, charging, CRM, network management, and other critical systems.
Identify control gaps, risks, and compliance issues and provide practical recommendations.
Prepare audit working papers, findings, and reports.
Monitor and follow up on agreed remediation actions.
Assess compliance with IT policies, regulatory requirements, and frameworks such as COBIT, ISO 27001, NIST, and ITIL.

Review third-party, cloud, cybersecurity, and information security risks. Review adequacy and effectiveness of systems / procedures in place to address the risks in the areas/ departments/ functions being audited.
Identify and suggest opportunities for cost savings and cost control measures.
Discuss the critical audit observations with HODs and follow up on implementation of the agreed action plans.
Preparation of draft observations and discussion with the auditee
Draft the audit report and/ or provide necessary inputs for preparing audit report where applicable
Perform Follow-up reviews as per approved plan and audit programme

d: The Logistics Manager is responsible for leading and optimizing the Company's logistics, warehousing, transportation, inventory management, and distribution operations across multiple construction projects. The role ensures the efficient movement, storage, and delivery of materials, equipment, and resources to project sites while maintaining optimal inventory levels, minimizing excess and obsolete stock, and supporting project execution schedules.

The position oversees all logistics-related activities, including warehouse operations, fleet management, freight forwarding, customs clearance, and supply chain coordination. Working closely with project teams, procurement, suppliers, logistics service providers, and regulatory authorities, the Logistics Manager drives operational excellence, cost optimization, and continuous improvement while ensuring uninterrupted support to construction activities.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
Professional certifications such as CSCP, CLTD, CILT, or equivalent are an advantage.
Minimum 8 years of professional experience in logistics, supply chain, warehousing, transportation, or related functions.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in a logistics management or supervisory role.
Proven experience in the construction, infrastructure, engineering, or industrial sectors is mandatory.
Demonstrated experience supporting multiple project sites and managing the logistics of construction materials, equipment, and project resources.
Strong background in warehousing, inventory management, transportation, and project logistics.
Experience in import/export operations, customs clearance, freight forwarding, and supplier coordination.
Minimum 2 years of GCC experience is preferred.
Comprehensive knowledge of logistics operations, including transportation, warehousing, inventory management, distribution, and supply chain optimization.
Strong understanding of construction project logistics and material management.
Proven experience in inventory control, warehouse management, stock accuracy, and material distribution.
Advanced knowledge of fleet management, route planning, transportation scheduling, and resource allocation.
Proficiency in logistics and inventory management systems.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Experience in business process improvement and cost optimization initiatives.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational and project management capabilities with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
r: Develop and implement logistics strategies, policies, procedures, and best practices to enhance operational efficiency and financial performance.
Establish and maintain optimal inventory levels while reducing obsolete, aging, and non-conforming materials.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of inventory transactions and the physical movement of materials from receipt through storage, distribution, and final delivery to project sites.
Design and implement logistics tools, methodologies, and standard operating procedures to improve operational effectiveness.
Plan, coordinate, and manage logistics operations in collaboration with project teams, procurement, suppliers, transportation providers, freight forwarders, and customers.
Oversee the transportation and delivery of construction materials, equipment, and project resources to ensure timely availability at project locations.
Manage import and export activities, including customs clearance and coordination with shipping lines, freight forwarders, and government authorities.
Monitor warehouse operations and inventory accuracy to ensure alignment between physical inventory and ERP records.
Lead fleet management activities, including vehicle utilization, route optimization, maintenance coordination, and transportation planning.
Identify and resolve logistics, transportation, inventory, and supply chain issues while maintaining high service levels and cost efficiency.
Analyze logistics and inventory data, identify trends, and recommend improvements to enhance operational performance and reduce costs.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives and implement solutions that improve productivity, service quality, and resource utilization.
Prepare and present logistics reports, KPIs, and performance metrics to management.
Ensure compliance with company policies, health and safety standards, and applicable local and international regulations.
x: Join a dynamic organization delivering large-scale construction and infrastructure projects, where you will play a critical role in ensuring the seamless flow of materials, equipment, and resources that drive project success. This position offers the opportunity to lead complex logistics operations, implement innovative solutions, and contribute directly to operational excellence across the organization.
